exact: MyD88 adapter-like dependent toll-like receptor 4 signaling pathway

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by a ligand binding to a toll-like receptor 4 where the TIRAP/MAL adaptor mediates transduction of the signal. Toll-like 4 receptors are pattern recognition receptors that bind bacterial lipopolysaccharide (LPS) to initiate an innate immune response.
label: TIRAP-dependent toll-like receptor 4 signaling pathway
